description: A large-scale, LLM-assisted and validated dataset of biomass and waste conversion technologies and feedstocks is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Zahir Barahmand et al. Biomass, organic wastes and by-products are increasingly targeted for low-carbon fuels and value-added chemicals. However, strategic decision-making from a circular economy perspective requires a big-picture view of the relative significance of different conversion technologies in handling diverse feedstock portfolios, and no large-scale, cross-technology mapping of these portfolios is currently available. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: ZIP, TXT. The data are held in DataverseNO and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 68585. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
